notes.title: 🧾 Playtest Update #2
notes.content:
Thanks for sticking with us - in this update we've reworked progression, added new mechanics and fixed a lot of issues!

Here's the info about this patch:
⚠️ Global changes
- All restaurants have been wiped - this is necessary for the new version to work correctly.
- Added a new mechanic with the VIP guest Goblin. Dance in front of him to impress him!

🍽 Gameplay and Interaction
- Fixed a bug with perks in customers, which could cause it to be saved incorrectly after restarting.
- Serving counter rework
- Fixes related to levels and items that could fly out of the restaurant.
- Changed how the guest summoning horn works - taxes are now paid differently.
- Updated experience balance.

🏗 Construction and visuals
- Fixed issues with light and shadows in rooms.
- Fixed building - no more empty or red areas interfering with object placement.
- Added a single zoom setting that adjusts both fonts and all UI elements.
- Updated the text when creating a lobby - "Steam Friends' Lobbies" is now used instead of "Lobby" to avoid confusion: it's a friends-only lobby.

🎓 Tutorial and hints
- Improved hints in tutorial - now they are clearer and more specific.
- Added a hint about perks - press Escape to read their description.
- A hint added to the co-op tutorial playthrough, that everyone in the party need to open the shop, ring the bell, etc.

🃏 BlackJack
- Fixed a bug that could cause the dealer to freeze, not flip cards, or not give out winnings.
- Fixed Ace selection - now its value (1 or 11) is determined automatically.

👥 Visitors
- Fixed a bug that could cause 4 bosses to appear at once in one day - now the probability of their appearance is distributed correctly.

🌐 Localization
- Translation improvements and adjustments for all supported languages.

notes.title: Playtest update #1
notes.content:
⚠️ Heads up!
[h1][u][b]The next update will include a wipe of all restaurants.[/b][/u][/h1]

We apologize for the inconvenience and truly appreciate your understanding.
Thank you for playing the Restaurats playtest — it means a lot to us!

We’ve already fixed the major bugs and issues — check out the update details on Steam or our social media.

We're currently working on a shorter and more focused demo version that better showcases the core of the game.
The full version will feature 6 races, more furniture, and new events that will challenge your restaurant in exciting ways!

If you’re enjoying the game — please add it to your Steam wishlist.
It really helps us a lot! 

🍽 Gameplay & Mechanics
Cooking flow charts updated.

Card selection time increased: from 60 to 150 seconds.

Interaction radius increased across all modes.

Complex dishes now cost more to reflect their value.

VIP clients always pay correctly for their orders.

Fixed VIP goblin debuff behavior.

Increased visitor count for 3 and 4 player games.

📦 Delivery & Storage
Opening a dish card now automatically delivers 10 full sets of ingredients.

Delivery worker now:

Pays for their own orders.

Waits longer when being served.

Fixed bug where clients didn’t leave after paying.

Fixed issue with getting stuck in the storage area.

🪑 Visitors & Behavior
Fixed name color display bug for clients.

No more getting stuck near chairs — everyone sits and leaves as expected.

Event logic improved — buffs now work properly and last longer.

🎨 Visuals & UI
Fixed skin color issues.

Added a wipe warning message for the upcoming update.

Added new serving counter and reworked restaurant delivery window.

Fixed DLSS flickering issue on food boxes.

Lighting and shadows optimized — restaurants now look better.

📦 Food & Packaging
Potatoes with mushrooms: raw version no longer comes with a plate.

Chicken nuggets no longer cause errors.

🎮 Multiplayer
Blackjack: joining during an ongoing session is now blocked.

Steam lobby: avatar no longer required to join friends.

🧠 Tutorial & Localization
Helpful tips added to the tutorial — onboarding is easier now.

Localization wording improved — clearer, more polished, more enjoyable.
